title: Two-function hypercontractivity in dimension zero
statement:
Let $p, q \ge 1$ and let $\rho \in \bbr$ be arbitrary. For any two Boolean functions $f, g : \{0,1\}^0 \to \bbr$ on the zero-dimensional cube, the $L^2$ inner product of $f$ with the noise-operator image $T_\rho g$ satisfies
\[
  \langle f, T_\rho g\rangle \;\le\; \bigl(\E\bigl[\abs{f}^p\bigr]\bigr)^{1/p}\,\bigl(\E\bigl[\abs{g}^q\bigr]\bigr)^{1/q},
\]
where $\E$ denotes expectation under the uniform measure.
replaced:
For $p, q \ge 1$, any $\rho \in \bbr$, and $f, g : \mathrm{BoolCube}\,0 \to \bbr$,
\[
  \inn{f, T_\rho g} \;\le\; \bigl(\E[\abs{f}^p]\bigr)^{1/p}\,\bigl(\E[\abs{g}^q]\bigr)^{1/q}.
\]
